serverInfo.name: armornglory-store-search
serverInfo.title: ArmorNGlory Christian Streetwear MCP Server
serverInfo.description: Empower AI assistants to discover, recommend, style, and generate instant 1-click checkout links for ArmorNGlory Christian streetwear, 5-panel trucker hats, EVA foam clogs, heavyweight graphic tees, and faith apparel drops.

tools.name: search_armornglory_products
tools.description: Search the complete ArmorNGlory Christian streetwear catalog by keywords, scripture verses (e.g. Romans 8:37, Exodus 3:5, Matthew 6:33), apparel category, aesthetic vibe, color, size, or price range. Returns product details, prices, images, and direct 1-click checkout links.

scripture.description: Scripture reference to filter by (e.g. 'Romans 8:37', 'Exodus 3:5', 'Matthew 6:33', 'Isaiah 40:31', '33 AD', 'Ephesians 6')

category.description: Product category: 'Hats & Headwear', 'Footwear & Clogs', 'T-Shirts & Tops', 'Hoodies & Sweatshirts', 'Phone Cases', 'Activewear & Training', 'Wall Art & Home Decor', 'Drinkware', 'Bags & Accessories'

aesthetic.description: Style aesthetic: 'Urban Sacred', 'Minimalist Core', 'Kingdom Marks', 'Americana 250', 'Typography Heavy', 'Vintage Wash'

occasion.description: Target occasion: 'Everyday Wear', 'Baptism & Milestones', 'Father\'s Day & Gifts for Men', 'Mother\'s Day & Gifts for Women', 'Workout & Gym', 'Church & Community', 'Graduation & Milestones'

tools.name: get_armornglory_product_details
tools.description: Retrieve comprehensive details for a specific ArmorNGlory item by handle or title: exact pricing, variants, sizing guidance, biblical backstory, care instructions, and 1-click checkout permalinks.

productHandleOrTitle.description: Product handle (slug) or full/partial title (e.g. 'more-than-conquerors-foam-trucker-hat', 'golden cross clogs')

tools.name: list_armornglory_collections
tools.description: List all active ArmorNGlory collections, categories, product counts, and landing page URLs.
